narrative.overview: This system treats a resume as an official document rather than a marketing page. The visual world is a registrar's transcript: a ruled sheet of warm record paper lying on a desk, its divisions separated by hairlines, its columns headed in small tracked capitals, and its one claim to authority made by a seal struck into the paper. Density is deliberately low and the reading order is fixed, because the reader is scanning rather than reading. Depth is real rather than implied: the record is one physical sheet inside a viewing volume, and one piece of motion carries the page — the seal resolving from an embossed outset to an inset as it is pressed.
keyCharacteristics: Warm throughout. No blue-grays, no pure black, no pure white.
One ink, one place. The carmine appears exactly once per screen.
Hairlines and rules do the structural work; shadows only carry relief.
Motion is one authored gesture and it is optional.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: The reserved carmine appears exactly once per screen, on the current appointment. Never on links, hover states, badges, buttons, or section headings. Interactive states use dense ink.

rules.name: The Warmth Rule
rules.body: No blue-grey anywhere. Every neutral is tinted warm toward the paper. A cool grey reads as a template; a warm one reads as a document.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow, no kicker, no small label above a heading. A heading carries its own weight. Field labels are permitted only where they name a column or a value.

rules.name: The Reference Code Rule
rules.body: Reference codes are numbered only when the number carries information. Decorative numbering is prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Only the sheet and the seal carry a resting shadow; every other element separates with a hairline.

rules.name: The One Gesture Rule
rules.body: Depth appears in exactly one authored moment — the seal press. Everything else is static or a state change, and all of it is suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.

dos: Do keep every vertical measurement on the 1.75rem baseline.
Do keep prose at or under 68ch in Archivo at 0.95rem or larger.
Do let sections with no content render nothing at all, heading and nav link included.
Do keep internal links going through withBase() so the deployment base path is applied.
Do set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on anything that is a measurement.
Do suppress the sheet tilt and every layer transform under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
donts: Don't use the reserved carmine for anything but the current appointment.
Don't add a second accent colour, a --color-accent token, or a blue-grey neutral.
Don't add a tailwind.config.js — Tailwind 4 has no config file; tokens live in @theme.
Don't tilt individual cards or animate sections on scroll.
Don't use glass, backdrop blur, gradient text, or Unicode glyphs as icons.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't let screen styling reach the printable copy.
